findings.reason: MI001, Mouse panel-to-regimen matching, remains AMBIGUOUS with resolution_status OPEN and needed_at prepare. Origin is main:/missing_information/items/0. Original impact: Mouse panels cannot be treated as matched regimen-level exposure-response records without verification. Original basis: The proposal explicitly states that separate mouse panels are not verified matched regimen records; attachment bodies have not been searched. This supplied page supports a local Figure 3e–strain–MIC–regimen–response association, but F0003:S1:T7:A87 explicitly states: No matched measured PK for these efficacy regimens. This page does not resolve the wider panel-matching item or support a regimen-level exposure-response join.
findings.needed_material: Verify the panel, regimen, strain-MIC and response associations required by SC032, documenting supported matches and unresolved links. Retain MI001 for the prepare-stage decision and obtain source-supported exposure inputs and their relationship to the efficacy regimen before accepting a matched exposure-response record.
